name: Steamed Baby Bok Choy with Tamari (Restaurant Style Side)
whyItWorks: Tender whole baby bok choy steamed until wilted and soft, drizzled with gluten-free tamari and sesame oil. Safe dining side when ordered plain without chili oil or heavy garlic.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order steamed baby bok choy plain with gluten-free tamari and sesame oil on the side. Avoid crunchy garlic flakes or chili oil toppings.
